mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photos (user_id, original_filename, stored_filename, content_type, size_bytes, taken_at, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{userId}, #{originalFilename}, #{storedFilename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{takenAt}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, original_filename, stored_filename, content_type, size_bytes, created_at, taken_at, latitude, longitude, trip_id FROM photos WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, original_filename, stored_filename, content_type, size_bytes, created_at, taken_at, latitude, longitude, trip_id FROM photos WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY created_at, id
SELECT stored_filename FROM photos WHERE trip_id = #{tripId}
mapper.update: UPDATE photos SET trip_id = #{tripId} WHERE id = #{id}
